[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised that both black and white and color have their advantages and that the choice depends on personal vision and style.

[EVENT] User is thinking of organizing a photography walk around their neighborhood to practice street photography skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised against bringing a tripod for the photography walk, citing reasons such as mobility, discretion, flexibility, and size/weight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested using a prime lens, shooting handheld, keeping the camera ready, and focusing on observation during the photography walk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant emphasized the importance of developing skills and confidence in street photography.
